# Stockfish.js 19.0.1

The extension bundles the lite, single-threaded Stockfish.js 19.0.1 engine:

- `stockfish-19-lite-single.js` and `stockfish-19-lite-single.wasm` are the
  upstream release assets in the extension directory.
- `stockfish.js-source-v19.0.1.tar.gz` is the matching upstream source archive.
- `nn-61e7af4bb97d.nnue` is the matching lite evaluation network.
- `Copying.txt` and `AUTHORS` contain the upstream license and attribution.

Upstream: <https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/tree/v19.0.1>
